slides.headline: What did she just hear behind this fence?
A young woman leans on a fence, hand on her *heart*.
Her face is pale. She is holding back *tears*.
Her whole body leans on the fence, as if she might *fall*.
Her other hand trails along the rough *wood*.
She wears fine blue silk. Was she *waiting* for him?
Now look through the gap at the top of the *fence*.
Another couple. He offers the other girl a *flower*.
Through a second crack, another face *peeks* out.
Ivy climbs above her, an old symbol of faithful *love*.
Calderon hid clues like these for viewers to *decode*.
She heard everything. Confront them, or walk *away*?
